name: Crew Orbit
summary: A 3D team carousel you can drag, where only the person in the middle is in colour
about: A team section that arranges illustrated portrait cards on a curved 3D ring. The cards fan out from the middle when the page opens, the ring follows your finger or mouse as you drag and snaps to the nearest person, and the person in the middle floats forward in full colour and tilts toward your pointer with a soft glare. Their name, role, bio and skills slide in below. Good for team pages on agency, studio or company sites.
how: Drag or swipe the row: the cards turn with your finger in real time, and a quick flick carries on a little further before snapping.
Or press the arrow buttons, click a dot, click any side card, or focus the row and use the Left and Right arrow keys.
The new centre card gains colour and floats forward while the others fade to grey; hover it to tilt it in 3D.
The name, role, bio and skill chips below arrive one after another and are announced to screen readers.
